1.text: At times I can't control the urge to harm someone.

2.text: Sometimes I gossip about people I don't like.

3.text: I get irritated easily, but I calm down easily too.

4.text: If I'm not asked nicely, I won't do what I'm asked.

5.text: I don't always get what I'm entitled to.

6.text: I know people talk about me behind my back.

7.text: If I disapprove of what others do, I let them feel it.

8.text: If I happen to deceive someone, I feel remorse.

9.text: I don't think I could hit anyone.

10.text: I never get so irritated that I throw things around.

11.text: I am always tolerant of other people's shortcomings.

12.text: When I don't like a rule, I feel like breaking it.

13.text: Others almost always know how to take advantage of a favourable situation.

14.text: I'm wary of people who are friendlier to me than I expect.

16.text: Sometimes thoughts come to mind that I'm ashamed of.

17.text: If someone hits me, I won't hit back.

19.text: I am more irritable than I seem.

20.text: If someone acts like they are the boss, I do the opposite of what they want.

21.text: My lot in life upsets me a little.

22.text: I think many people don't like me.

23.text: I can't keep from arguing when people disagree with me.

24.text: People who shirk work should feel guilty.

25.text: Anyone who insults me or my family is asking for a fight.

26.text: I'm not capable of crude jokes.

27.text: I'm filled with rage when people make fun of me.

28.text: When people act like they are the boss, I do everything to cut them down to size.

29.text: Almost every week I see someone I don't like.

30.text: Quite a lot of people envy me.

31.text: I demand that people respect my rights.

32.text: It upsets me that I do so little for my parents.

33.text: People who constantly pester you deserve to be put in their place.

34.text: Sometimes I'm sullen out of anger.

35.text: If I'm treated worse than I deserve, I don't get upset.

36.text: If someone tries to provoke me, I ignore them.

37.text: Although I don't show it, envy sometimes gnaws at me.

38.text: Sometimes I feel that people are laughing at me.

39.text: Even when I'm angry, I don't use strong language.

40.text: I wish my sins were forgiven.

41.text: I rarely hit back, even if someone hits me.

42.text: I feel hurt when things don't go my way.

43.text: Sometimes people irritate me just by being there.

44.text: There is no one I truly hate.

46.text: If someone irritates me, I'm ready to tell them exactly what I think of them.

47.text: I do a lot of things I later regret.

48.text: If I get angry, I could hit someone.

49.text: I haven't had outbursts of anger since I was ten.

50.text: I often feel like a powder keg ready to explode.

51.text: If people knew how I feel, they would think I'm hard to get along with.

52.text: I always wonder what hidden reasons make people do something nice for me.

53.text: When people shout at me, I shout back.

55.text: I get into fights no more and no less often than others.

56.text: I can remember times when I was so angry that I grabbed the nearest thing and broke it.

57.text: Sometimes I feel ready to start a fight.

58.text: Sometimes I feel that life treats me unfairly.

59.text: I used to think most people tell the truth, but now I don't believe it.

60.text: I swear only when I'm angry.

61.text: When I do something wrong, my conscience torments me.

62.text: If I have to use physical force to defend my rights, I use it.

63.text: Sometimes I express my anger by banging on the table.

64.text: I can be rude to people I don't like.

65.text: I have no enemies who would want to harm me.

66.text: I can't put someone in their place, even when they deserve it.

67.text: I often think I'm living my life the wrong way.

68.text: I know people who could drive me to a fight.

69.text: I don't get upset over little things.

70.text: It rarely occurs to me that people are afraid to anger or offend me.

71.text: I often threaten people without meaning to carry out the threats.

73.text: I often raise my voice in an argument.

74.text: I try to hide my dislike of people.

75.text: I'd rather agree with something than argue.
